finish.summary:
**Bug:** When the Webhook node's "Ignore Bots" option rejected a request, it threw `WebhookAuthorizationError(403)` without a custom message, causing the error constructor to default to the generic `"Authorization data is wrong!"` message. This was misleading when no authentication was configured.

**Fix:** Pass an explicit, meaningful message as the second argument to `WebhookAuthorizationError` at the bot-rejection call site in `packages/nodes-base/nodes/Webhook/Webhook.node.ts`:

```ts
throw new WebhookAuthorizationError(
    403,
    'Request rejected: bot detected. Set the "Ignore Bots" option to false to allow bots.',
);
```

The status code remains 403 (no behavioural change), but the response body now clearly explains the actual cause instead of misleading users into thinking there's an authorization problem.

**Tests:** Added `packages/nodes-base/nodes/Webhook/test/Webhook.ignoreBots.test.ts` with 3 tests:
1. Verifies a bot user-agent (`Mozilla/5.0`) is rejected with the new meaningful message (this test fails without the fix, showing "Authorization data is wrong!" instead)
2. Verifies a non-bot user-agent (real Chrome UA) is allowed through
3. Verifies requests pass through when `ignoreBots` is not enabled

Also added the same test block to the existing `Webhook.test.ts` suite (currently skipped due to pre-existing dist build issues, but will run when the package is properly built).
finish.risks: Minimal. The only change is providing a custom message string to an existing error class; the HTTP status code (403) and all other control flow are unchanged. The message references the "Ignore Bots" option name which could become stale if the UI label changes, but it's a minor cosmetic risk.
finish.tests_run: `cd packages/nodes-base && pnpm exec vitest run nodes/Webhook/test/Webhook.ignoreBots.test.ts` — 3/3 passed. Verified the first test fails without the fix (expects new message but receives "Authorization data is wrong!").
